meta.title: Stept — the open-source Intercom + Fin alternative
meta.description: Shared inbox, an AI agent that resolves on your own knowledge base, help center, product tours and automation. Self-host it free, or let us run it.
hero.badge: The agent doesn’t just answer — it shows and does
hero.title: Customer support that resolves itself.
hero.lead: Stept is the open-source Intercom + Fin alternative: a shared inbox across every channel, an AI agent grounded in your own knowledge base, a help center, product tours and automation. Self-host it free — bring your own model key — or let us run it.
hero.note: MIT-licensed · runs offline with zero API keys · Postgres or SQLite
hero.shot_alt: The Stept shared inbox with a customer conversation open, showing the thread, contact panel and reply composer
strip.label: Connects to the tools your customers and team already use
agent.title: An agent with hands.
agent.lead: Most support AI stops at text. Stept’s agent reads your docs, guides people through your actual UI, and — with consent — acts on the page. Every run leaves a full step-by-step trace you can audit.
agent.shows.title: It shows, instead of telling
agent.shows.body: Rather than describing five steps, the agent finds the right product tour and plays it — or composes a walkthrough on the spot, with coach-marks on your real interface.
agent.acts.title: It acts — with consent and a brake
agent.acts.body: With the visitor’s explicit opt-in it clicks, fills and navigates for them. Sensitive tools pause for human approval, password fields are off-limits, and actions are capped per run.
agent.mcp.title: Your workspace is an MCP server
agent.mcp.body: Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can search your knowledge, read conversations, write docs — even drive a real browser through the recorder extension.
agent.shot_alt: An agent run in Stept showing the full execution trace: LLM call, tool call to search_knowledge, tool result, and the final reply, with token counts and timings
product.title: Everything a support team needs — in one place.
product.lead: Intercom bundles the inbox, the AI agent, the help center and product tours, then charges for each. Stept ships all of it in one open-source platform.
product.builder.title: Configure the agent, then watch what it does
product.builder.body: Pick the model, write the persona, and set every tool to auto, approval-required or off. Test it in a sandbox that shows the live reasoning trace before anything reaches a customer.
product.builder.shot_alt: The Stept AI agent builder: identity, model, temperature and system prompt, with a test sandbox on the right
product.knowledge.title: Knowledge that keeps itself fresh
product.knowledge.body: Crawl, upload or sync. Sources re-index on a schedule and prune pages that disappear.
product.knowledge.shot_alt: The Stept knowledge base listing sources and indexed documents
product.tours.title: Tours, recorded by clicking
product.tours.body: Record a flow in your own app with the Chrome extension; steps self-heal when your markup moves.
product.tours.shot_alt: Product tours in Stept, showing published tours with step counts and completion analytics
features.inbox.title: One shared inbox
features.inbox.body: Assign, snooze, tag, note and resolve together — with SLAs, saved views, macros and realtime collaboration across the team.
features.knowledge.title: Knowledge that stays current
features.knowledge.body: Crawl your site, upload files, or sync Notion, Confluence, Drive, Zendesk and GitHub. Hybrid retrieval feeds the agent, the reply copilot and your help center.
features.automation.title: Automation & reporting
features.automation.body: Rules, macros, campaigns, SLAs and webhooks — plus analytics on volume, resolution rate, CSAT and how often the AI deflects a conversation.
features.teams.title: Built for real teams
features.teams.body: Multi-workspace tenancy, RBAC with custom roles, audit log, scoped API keys, encrypted provider secrets and a hardened deploy.
band.title: Run your own Fin-class agent — free.
band.lead: Most AI-support tools bill per resolution or lock the agent behind an enterprise plan. Stept ships the agent in the open-source core. Point it at your own model key and self-host the whole platform at no cost.
band.item1: Bring your own model — no per-resolution fee
band.item2: Your data stays in your own database
band.item3: Runs offline: mock AI provider, zero keys
band.item4: No seat caps when you self-host

pricing.foot: AI resolutions beyond your plan will bill at about $0.30–0.49 each — around half of Intercom Fin’s $0.99. A 5-seat team pays about $95/mo on Stept Cloud; the same team on Intercom + Fin typically runs $1,000+/mo.
faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.open_source.a: Yes — the whole platform is MIT-licensed: inbox, AI agent, knowledge base, help center, tours, automation. Self-host everything with your own model key. Cloud is just us running the same code for you.
faq.models.q: Which AI models can I use?
faq.models.a: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Keys are stored per workspace and encrypted at rest, and there is no markup on tokens — you pay your provider directly. A deterministic mock provider ships in the box, so the entire AI stack runs offline with zero API keys.
faq.resolution.a: A conversation the agent resolves without a human stepping in. Self-hosted installs meter nothing at all. On Cloud, plan quotas apply once pricing turns on — during early access everything is free.
faq.actions.q: Can the agent really act on the page?
faq.actions.a: Only with the visitor’s explicit per-conversation consent. Actions are capped per run, password fields are never touched, navigation is same-origin by default, and any tool can be set to require a human approval before it executes.
faq.data.a: Self-hosted: in your own Postgres, full stop. On Stept Cloud your workspace runs on EU infrastructure, model keys are encrypted at rest, and your conversations are never used to train anything.
faq.migrate.q: Can I migrate from Intercom or Zendesk?
faq.migrate.a: Import contacts by CSV, pull help-center content in with the website crawler or the Zendesk connector, and keep your address by forwarding mail to your Stept inbox. Email us and we will help.

privacy.meta.title: Privacy — Stept
privacy.meta.description: How Stept handles your data: what we collect, where it lives, and your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.who.title: Who we are
privacy.who.body: Stept ("we") provides an open-source customer-support platform, available self-hosted and as a hosted service at app.stepped.ai ("Stept Cloud"). Contact: hello@stepped.ai.
privacy.selfhosted.title: Self-hosted installs
privacy.selfhosted.body: If you self-host Stept, we collect nothing. All data stays in your own infrastructure and your own database. The software makes no calls home — the only outbound requests are the ones you configure (your AI provider, your email transport, your integrations).
privacy.store.title: Stept Cloud — what we store
privacy.store.account: Account data: your email address, name and password hash.
privacy.store.workspace: Workspace content: conversations, contacts, knowledge documents, articles, tours and settings your team creates — processed solely to provide the service to you.
privacy.store.credentials: Provider credentials: AI model keys and channel tokens you connect are encrypted at rest.
privacy.store.logs: Technical logs: IP addresses and request metadata, kept short-term for security and rate limiting.
privacy.where.title: Where it lives
privacy.where.body: Stept Cloud runs on EU infrastructure (Hetzner). Traffic is served through Cloudflare for TLS and DDoS protection.
privacy.ai.title: AI processing
privacy.ai.body: When your workspace uses an AI feature, the relevant conversation and knowledge excerpts are sent to the model provider you configured with your key. We do not train models on your data and we add no hidden providers.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: You can export or delete your workspace data at any time — email hello@stepped.ai for GDPR requests (access, rectification, erasure, portability).
privacy.subprocessors.title: Sub-processors
privacy.subprocessors.body: Hetzner Online GmbH (hosting, EU) · Cloudflare, Inc. (network/TLS) · the AI and email providers you explicitly connect.
